_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-78b. postSummaryOnClean: false on a clean diff suppresses the summary COMMENT only. The check still reports its passing conclusion, and the formal Review event is still submitted — APPROVE on a clean PR. The README previously listed "no formal Review event" as an expected outcome; that was wrong and this fixture failed on it (mergewatch.ai run 33582978649). The product is correct: the setting is named for the summary and `shouldStaySilent` (mergewatch.ai#664) gates only the comment post, and a failed gating custom agent (blocking org, or repo) always posts. The failure this fixture catches is the setting silently suppressing the CHECK too, which would remove the only remaining merge signal. The flip-to-true half needs a push and stays manual.
_variance: any built-in critical (a refuted one is demoted, not dropped) or the seeded no-todo org agent posts the summary and flips APPROVED.
